chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Bint Ilyas from Abdillah ibn Sinan who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: The leftover drink of a believer is a cure for seventy diseases.

key_terms.سُؤْر: Leftover drink or saliva residue in a glass

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical benefit of drinking from a believer's leftover glass?
ai.summary: In *Thawab al-A'mal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to highlight the tangible spiritual and physical barakah (blessing) inherent in the piety of a believer. The concept of *su'rah* (the remainder of a drink) serves as a metaphor for the shared sanctity and purity that transfers from the devout to those who partake, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the interconnection of spiritual status and physical well-being. This tradition underscores how the inner state of faith manifests in outward, healing properties, reinforcing the believer's role as a source of divine mercy.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2.  Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) said, “A drink leftover in the glass of a believer has cure to seventy diseases.”
